title: Context Engineering
description: Master the art of structuring and compressing project knowledge to maximize AI situational awareness and reduce hallucinations.
learning_objectives: Create a high-density project context file for LLM consumption
Implement XML tagging to structure complex project data
Apply compression techniques to fit large codebases into the context window
Establish a workflow for maintaining an evolving project memory system
prerequisites: Basic understanding of LLM context windows

sections.heading: The Context Bottleneck
sections.content_brief: Explain the difference between 'raw' context (dumping files) and 'engineered' context. Discuss why too much irrelevant information leads to 'lost in the middle' phenomena and hallucinations.

sections.heading: Building a Project Knowledge Base
sections.content_brief: Guide the reader in creating a dedicated memory file (e.g., PROJECT_CONTEXT.md). Detail exactly what to include: tech stack, core architectural patterns, naming conventions, and critical business logic constraints.
sections.code_context: A template for a comprehensive project context file including sections for Tech Stack, Architecture, and Rules.

sections.heading: Structuring with XML Tags
sections.content_brief: Demonstrate how to use XML-style tags (e.g., <architecture>, <constraints>) to help Claude parse different types of information. Explain why structured delimiters are more effective than plain text for complex instructions.
sections.code_context: An example prompt using XML tags to separate project goals from technical constraints.

sections.heading: Context Compression Techniques
sections.content_brief: Teach methods for reducing token usage without losing meaning. Cover 'skeletonizing' code (providing function signatures and docstrings but removing implementation bodies) and creating directory maps.
sections.code_context: Comparison between a full source file and its compressed 'skeleton' version for context delivery.

sections.heading: The Iterative Memory Loop
sections.content_brief: Explain the process of updating the context file as the project evolves. Discuss how to ask the AI to suggest updates to the memory file after a major feature implementation.
sections.code_context: A prompt used to instruct Claude to update the PROJECT_CONTEXT.md based on recent changes.

admonitions.content: Avoid 'Context Stuffing.' Adding every file in your project doesn't make the AI smarter; it often increases noise and leads to the AI ignoring specific instructions.
Use tools like 'repomix' or custom scripts to automatically generate directory structures and skeleton files for your context engineering workflow.
